title: On some convergence approach structures on hyperspaces
summary: In the context of the category $\mathsf{Cap}$ of convergence approach spaces and contractions, we introduce and study approach analogs of the upper and lower Kuratowski convergences, upper-Fell and Fell topologies on the set of closed subsets of the coreflection on the category $\mathsf{Conv}$ of convergence spaces of a convergence approach space.
